exposure: enrollment in a remote hypertension management program
cohort: Postpartum individuals diagnosed with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) who delivered at a single institution between March 2019 and June 2023.
finding: Participation in a postpartum remote BP monitoring program was associated with fewer postpartum hospital readmissions, higher attendance at postpartum visits, improved guideline adherence, and higher rates of antihypertensive medication use.
